cards.title: Plan golden tests for card light, dark, and scale
cards.when: Use this when a card's typography must be locked by screenshot diffs so later token changes are caught.
cards.cmds:
find test -name "*golden*"
touch test/card_typography_golden_test.dart
flutter test --help

cards.title: Plan text-scale overflow tests for card titles
cards.when: Use this when a card title or body must survive the user's larger system font size without clipping or overflowing.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "textScaler|textScaleFactor" lib
flutter test test/widgets

cards.title: Confirm token plan against the codebase before building
cards.when: Use this at the end of planning to confirm every named token is real and to set the count the build stage must reach.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "Color(0x" lib/widgets/card
grep -rn "EdgeInsets.all(" lib/widgets/card
cat docs/card_tokens.md
dart analyze

cards.title: Animate form input focus ring with box-shadow transition
cards.when: Use this when a text input needs a visible focus ring that eases in instead of snapping on.
cards.cmds:
grep -n focus-visible styles.css
rg -n transition styles.css
npx stylelint styles.css

cards.title: Shake invalid field with keyframes on user-invalid
cards.when: Use this when a required field fails validation and the user needs a short, clear motion cue.
cards.cmds:
grep -n user-invalid styles.css
npx playwright test tests/form-shake.spec.js

cards.title: Wrap form transitions in prefers-reduced-motion query
cards.when: Use this for any form animation so users who set reduced motion in their OS see no movement.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -E 'transition|animation' form.css
npx playwright test --grep reduced-motion
npx stylelint form.css

cards.title: Show loading spinner on submit button with transform
cards.when: Use this when a submit button starts a network request and must show progress without changing its width.
cards.cmds:
grep -n submit index.html
npx playwright test tests/submit-loading.spec.js

cards.title: Reveal error message with grid-template-rows transition
cards.when: Use this when an inline error must expand smoothly below a field without animating height directly.
cards.cmds:
grep -n error-message index.html
rg -n grid-template-rows form.css
npx playwright test tests/error-reveal.spec.js

cards.title: Float label above input using placeholder-shown transform
cards.when: Use this when a text field needs a label that moves above the input on focus or when filled, using only CSS.
cards.cmds:
grep -n placeholder index.html
npx prettier --check form.css
npx playwright test tests/float-label.spec.js

cards.title: Audit hardcoded card text styles before planning tokens
cards.when: Use this first when a Flutter card still has inline TextStyle values and you need the list of literals to replace.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "TextStyle\(" lib
grep -rc "fontSize:" lib/widgets/card
touch docs/card_typography_audit.md
flutter --version
flutter analyze lib/widgets/card

cards.title: Scan Tabs.vue for hardcoded typography values
cards.when: Use this after editing Tabs.vue to confirm that no raw font sizes or colors bypass the design tokens.
cards.cmds:
grep -n font-size src/components/Tabs.vue
grep -ciE 'color: #[0-9a-f]' src/components/Tabs.vue
grep -c 'var(--tab-' src/components/Tabs.vue
npx vitest run src/components/Tabs.spec.ts

cards.title: Assert computed tab font size with Playwright
cards.when: Use this when a tab's typography changes and you need proof of the resolved pixel values in a real browser.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/tabs-typography.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/tabs-typography.spec.ts --reporter=line
grep -n expect tests/tabs-typography.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/tabs-typography.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Verify tab text contrast with axe in dev
cards.when: Use this when tab colors or backgrounds change and you need a WCAG AA contrast result from the running app.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx axe http://localhost:5173/tabs-demo --tags wcag2aa --exit
npx axe http://localhost:5173/tabs-demo --tags wcag2aa --save axe-tabs.json
grep -c color-contrast axe-tabs.json

cards.title: Confirm tab tokens are declared in the token file
cards.when: Use this when a new tab token is added or renamed, to confirm every token used by Tabs.vue is defined in the shared stylesheet.
cards.cmds:
grep -c -e '--tab-' src/styles/tokens.css
grep -n font-size src/styles/tokens.css
npx vue-tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Measure tab tap target height against 44px
cards.when: Use this when tab padding, font size, or line height changes, to confirm each tab still meets the 44px minimum target size.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/tabs-target.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/tabs-target.spec.ts --reporter=line
grep -n 44 tests/tabs-target.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/tabs-target.spec.ts --project=mobile-chrome --reporter=line

cards.title: Check the production bundle keeps tab tokens
cards.when: Use this before a release to confirm the built CSS contains every tab typography token that the source defines.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
grep -l -e '--tab-font-size' dist/assets/*.css
grep -oh -e '--tab-[a-z-]*' dist/assets/*.css
npx eslint src/components/Tabs.vue

cards.title: Check text contrast on onboarding with axe
cards.when: Use this after changing any color or background token used by onboarding text to prove it meets WCAG AA contrast.
cards.cmds:
curl -sI http://localhost:8080/onboarding.html
npx axe http://localhost:8080/onboarding.html --tags wcag2aa
npx axe http://localhost:8080/onboarding.html --tags wcag2aa

cards.title: Confirm computed font sizes across two viewports
cards.when: Use this after editing clamp() or rem values in onboarding headings to verify the rendered size at narrow and wide screens.
cards.cmds:
test -f tests/onboarding-typography.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-typography.spec.ts --project=chromium
grep -n 'toHaveCSS' tests/onboarding-typography.spec.ts

cards.title: Score onboarding accessibility with Lighthouse
cards.when: Use this before release to get a numeric accessibility score and a font-size audit result for the onboarding page.
cards.cmds:
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8080/onboarding.html --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./reports/onboarding.json
jq '.categories.accessibility.score' reports/onboarding.json
jq '.audits["font-size"].score' reports/onboarding.json

cards.title: Verify @font-face loads with font-display swap
cards.when: Use this after adding or changing web font files to confirm text is visible during load and the faces are actually used.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'font-display: swap' css/fonts.css
grep -c '@font-face' css/fonts.css
npx playwright test tests/fonts.spec.ts

cards.title: Confirm typography tokens exist on :root
cards.when: Use this before building onboarding styles to prove the design token file defines the type scale that the CSS will reference.
cards.cmds:
test -f styles/tokens.css
grep -n ':root' styles/tokens.css
grep -c -- '--type-' styles/tokens.css
npx playwright test tests/tokens.spec.ts

cards.title: Show a placeholder when the list has no items
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui List widget may receive zero items and the user must see a message instead of a blank box.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/ui
touch src/ui/empty.rs
cargo test renders_placeholder_when_empty
cargo test

cards.title: Render an error message in place of list rows
cards.when: Use this when loading the list fails and the screen must show the error in red with a retry hint instead of rows.
cards.cmds:
rg -n enum src/state.rs
cargo test error_state_shows_message
cargo check

cards.title: Model loading, empty, error and ready as one enum
cards.when: Use this at the start of building a list screen so each of the four states has exactly one rendering path.
cards.cmds:
touch src/state.rs
cargo test state::

cards.title: Clear list selection when items become empty
cards.when: Use this when a filter or refresh can shrink the list to zero rows and the stored selected index would point at nothing.
cards.cmds:
rg -n select src/app.rs
cargo test selection_clears_when_empty
cargo test

cards.title: Wrap long error text to the panel width
cards.when: Use this when an error message can be longer than the panel so it must wrap onto several rows instead of being cut at the border.
cards.cmds:
cargo test long_error_wraps
cargo test

cards.title: Assert empty and error frames render within 200ms
cards.when: Use this when the list screen must redraw quickly for empty and error states and you need a measured time budget.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/empty_render.rs
cargo test --test empty_render
cargo test --release --test empty_render

cards.title: Render empty state in light and dark with ImageRenderer
cards.when: Use this when the empty state view must be proven in both color schemes before merging.
cards.cmds:
grep -c "func test" Tests/EmptyStateTests/EmptyStateSnapshotTests.swift
xcodebuild test -scheme EmptyState -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' -only-testing:EmptyStateTests/EmptyStateSnapshotTests

cards.title: Assert 4.5:1 text contrast for empty state in both modes
cards.when: Use this when the empty state title and message colors must pass WCAG AA contrast in light and dark.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "4.5" Tests/EmptyStateTests/EmptyStateContrastTests.swift
swift test --filter EmptyStateContrastTests

cards.title: Check empty state layout at accessibility text size in dark mode
cards.when: Use this to confirm the empty state does not clip or truncate text at the largest Dynamic Type size in dark mode.
cards.cmds:
xcrun simctl ui booted content_size accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large
xcrun simctl ui booted appearance dark
xcodebuild test -scheme EmptyState -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' -only-testing:EmptyStateTests/EmptyStateLayoutTests
grep -n "dynamicTypeSize" Tests/EmptyStateTests/EmptyStateLayoutTests.swift

cards.title: Plan validator messages as localized keys, not literals
cards.when: Use this when a TextFormField validator returns an error message that must change with the user's language.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'validator:' lib/features/signup/signup_form.dart
grep -c 'validator:' lib/features/signup/signup_form.dart
flutter analyze lib/features/signup/

cards.title: Plan RTL-safe directional layout for localized forms
cards.when: Use this when the form must mirror correctly for right-to-left languages such as Arabic or Hebrew.
cards.cmds:
grep -rnE 'only[(]left|only[(]right|centerLeft|centerRight' lib/features/signup/
grep -rnE 'only[(]left|only[(]right|centerLeft|centerRight' lib/features/signup/
flutter test test/signup/signup_form_rtl_test.dart

cards.title: Plan locale-aware date and number formatting in forms
cards.when: Use this when the form shows a date, time, or currency that must follow the user's locale rather than a fixed pattern.
cards.cmds:
grep -rnE 'DateFormat[(]|NumberFormat[(]' lib/features/signup/
grep -rnE '[a-z][a-z]_[A-Z][A-Z]' lib/features/signup/
flutter test test/signup/

cards.title: Verify dark mode follows system preference on first visit
cards.when: Use after wiring useTheme to prefers-color-scheme and before merging the onboarding flow.

npm run dev -- --port 5173
npx playwright test tests/e2e/onboarding-theme.spec.ts --project=chromium
rg -n 'data-theme' tests/e2e/onboarding-theme.spec.ts

cards.title: Find hardcoded colors that break dark mode
cards.when: Use this to scan the empty state source for fixed colors that ignore the system appearance.
cards.cmds:
test -d Sources/EmptyState
grep -rn "Color(red" Sources/EmptyState
grep -rn "Color(hex" Sources/EmptyState
xcodebuild build -scheme EmptyState -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15'
xcodebuild test -scheme EmptyState -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' -only-testing:EmptyStateTests/ContrastTests

cards.title: Verify asset catalog color set has a dark variant
cards.when: Use this when the empty state uses a named color from Assets.xcassets that must differ in dark mode.
cards.cmds:
grep -c "\"color\"" Assets.xcassets/EmptyStateAccent.colorset/Contents.json
grep -c "\"dark\"" Assets.xcassets/EmptyStateAccent.colorset/Contents.json
cat Assets.xcassets/EmptyStateAccent.colorset/Contents.json
xcodebuild test -scheme EmptyState -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' -only-testing:EmptyStateTests/ContrastTests

cards.title: Animate container height with layout prop in motion
cards.when: Use when a React container's height changes on state toggle and the size change should animate instead of jumping.
cards.cmds:

npx tsc --noEmit
npx eslint src/components/Layout

cards.title: Animate list item removal with AnimatePresence and keys
cards.when: Use when items are added or removed from a React list and each exit should animate before the node leaves the DOM.
cards.cmds:
npm install motion
npx playwright test tests/animated-list.spec.ts

cards.title: Disable motion when user prefers reduced motion
cards.when: Use when a React layout animates with motion and must respect the operating system's reduced motion setting.
cards.cmds:
npx tsc --noEmit
grep -rn useReducedMotion src

cards.title: Slide sidebar drawer with CSS transform transition
cards.when: Use when a React sidebar should slide in and out with a CSS transition and no animation library.
cards.cmds:
grep -n transition src/components/Layout/Sidebar.module.css
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Animate accordion panel height from zero to auto
cards.when: Use when a React accordion panel must expand and collapse with a height animation whose target height is auto.

npx tsc --noEmit
npx playwright test tests/accordion.spec.ts

npx tsc --noEmit
npx playwright test tests/tabs.spec.ts

cards.when: Before writing any list motion, decide how many items animate and which ones stay static.

find . -name "*.css"
test -f css/motion.css

cards.title: Plan a reduced-motion fallback for list animations
cards.when: Before adding list animations, decide what users with reduced-motion settings see instead.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn prefers-reduced-motion .
find . -name "*.css"
stat css/motion.css

cards.when: Use when list items should animate as they scroll into view and browsers without animation-timeline need a plain fallback.
cards.cmds:

rg -n overflow styles.css
ls css

jq .categories.performance.score baseline.json

cards.title: Plan a slide-in sidebar drawer using transform only
cards.when: Use this when a page layout needs a sidebar that opens and closes with motion in plain HTML and CSS.

find . -name '*.css' -not -path './node_modules/*'
rg -n 'sidebar|drawer' --glob '*.css' --glob '*.html'

cards.when: Use this when a grid of cards should fade and rise in one after another on page load.
cards.cmds:

rg -n '@keyframes rise' styles

cards.title: Plan a reduced-motion fallback for all animations
cards.when: Use this before shipping any motion so users who request less motion get a static layout.
cards.cmds:

rg -n 'transition|animation' styles

cards.when: Use this when a disclosure panel needs to expand and collapse smoothly without JavaScript height measurement.

node --version

python3 -c "print(11*30+200)"
test 530 -lt 600

cards.title: Limit list motion to transform and opacity

rg -n "transition: all" .
rg -n "transition: .*(height|top|left)" .
echo "plan: allowed properties are transform and opacity only"
rg -n "transition: transform 200ms, opacity 200ms" .

cards.title: Plan a scroll-linked progress bar with a support guard
